sloka: प्रतिगृह्य तु तत्सर्वं रामः प्रीतिपुरस्कृतः ।तीर्थोदकानि सर्वाणि फलानि विविधानि च ।। ७.६०.९ ॥
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu tatsarvaṁ rāmaḥ prītipuraskṛtaḥ ।tīrthodakāni sarvāṇi phalāni vividhāni ca ।। 7.60.9 ॥

translations.english: Rama, showing great affection, received all those offerings, including all the sacred waters and various fruits.
